_comment: Locale pages Google has not indexed, measured 2026-11-11 with the URL Inspection API
(33 localized platform pages inspected: 28 PASS, 5 not). This file is the watch list
read by scripts/watch-unindexed.mjs; it is not generated, so remove a page here once it
is indexed and the page it names stops being checked. `observed` is the verdict that
put the page on the list, not a live value — the live value is in the run report.
The two English tool pages are watched here as well: they are what the GitHub Pages
crawl-bridge pages point at, so this is where the effect of that work becomes visible.
